caption: The drawing features a lidded urn or trophy-shaped vessel with two angular handles extending outward and upward from each side. The body of the vessel is rounded with a wide base, and it tapers gently towards the top, which is covered by a fitted lid that has a finial consisting of a rounded knob atop a short stem. The vessel's surface displays a central decorative motif consisting of a wreath encircling an arrangement of branches or leaves. A decorative band runs along the top edge just below the lid and another patterned border encircles the lower portion above the base. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray with precise, clean lines and subtle shading to indicate form, dimension, and texture. The composition is centered within a rectangular frame, and there is a signature in the lower right corner reading "Mc Mongiacotti." The background is plain and unadorned.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
